x: For the second time this season we entertained the police and also Cambridge Harriers for a seven miles event over our usual open course. Forty four started and Bob Richards, Cambridge, won a good race in 55.57 with Brian Shepherd 2nd in 57.46 and A.
Bob Richards needed three attempts to qualify in the pole vault and Oerter, who had not seen a discus a year ago, won the Gold Medal, while our own Mark Pharaoh missed third place by five inches.
The Pole Vault provided its usual American dominance with a great fight between Bob Richards and Don Laz although Europe, spearheaded by the USSR, were beginning to show prominently.
